summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its board approved R$515,000,000 of Interest on Shareholders' Equity, a Brazilian tax-advantaged shareholder distribution akin to a dividend. Gross value is R$0.2166801148 per share, though the final figure may shift with treasury-share buybacks. Record date is September 22, 2026; shares trade ex-rights thereafter, with payment by January 22, 2027. Withholding tax is 17.5% unless exemption is documented by September 22, 2026. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation apply; this is a routine capital return notice rather than a special situation.
